title: PUBG
description: PLAYERUNKNOWN'S BATTLEGROUNDS or more commonly called 'PUBG' is a multi-verse franchise that branches from competitive survival shooters (PUBG) to survival horror (The Callisto Protocol) video game titles. title: GTA 6 fans braced for painful release date
description:
GTA VI fans are terrified Rockstar Games is going to drop a bombshell when the release date gets announced.

Before December 2023 Grand Theft Auto fans were waiting for two things, a full trailer for GTA VI and a release date. They got the first bit when a trailer was dropped by Rockstar Games.
